title: Just Say the Word
reflectionQuestion: The captain trusted that Jesus could help, even from far away. I wonder when you might need to trust Jesus, even when you cannot see what he is doing?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Life, Matthew 8). WATCH-ITEM: the soldier is KIND (cares for his servant 'like family'); NO war/violence -- the 'authority' point is gentle (he gives orders, soldiers obey, so he trusts Jesus commands sickness). Room = great faith / Jesus' power reaches anywhere, even from far away / an unexpected outsider (a Roman) believes deeply. 'Just say the word' is the memorable line. Servant healed at-a-distance, that same hour. Soft close ('away'/'distance'). VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL_C_VINCENT (ear-verified male; warm, resonant).
